decisions.reason: The organic sliced platter has stayed on the website for two years and fits the firm's announced organic direction, so management will justify the investment and attribute modest results to market build-up rather than drop it.

The premium Salamissimo Aperitivo line was publicly promoted as new and even extended with a poultry variant in 2024, a visible escalation that makes withdrawal unlikely despite its move from its own page to a mention.

The organic Fleischwurst was launched publicly in 2024 as a new member of the 'Bio' team, so it is central to the organic strategy and too recent for disappointing results to be judged as anything but temporary.
Launched in 2024 in two flavours with its own page, the organic thin-sliced chicken breast carries fresh investment and public commitment, and any weak start will be read as a launch phase.
The organic herb-coated salami has just been launched with its own page within the organic range the firm is building, so management will persist with it at least another year.
